newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Feldschloesschen posts 18 mln Sfr H1 loss.
newsitem.headline: Feldschloesschen posts 18 mln Sfr H1 loss.

text.p: Swiss brewing and mineral water group Feldschloesschen-Huerlimann Holding AG posted an 18 million Swiss franc loss in the first half of the 1996/97 business year, it said.
This loss was smaller than forecast and was normal for seasonal reasons, it said in a statement.

Sales in the first half, which ended on March 31, totalled 522 million. Cash flow was 34 million, while EBIT was around two million, it said, adding these figures were not comparable with year-earlier data. Shares were down two francs at 400.
